messages:
sam.h: Heads-up — ACME reported a sudden drop in embeddings vectors/sec starting ~02:00 UTC. Tokens/sec looks normal. Not an auth or billing error. Anyone seen this pattern?
lia.k: Can you paste the ticket ID and a minimal repro? batch sizes, model id, dims?
support-jeff: Ticket #84217 — customer uses /v1/embeddings with model redwood-embed-16k, batch=32, dim=1536. They say vectors/sec dropped from ~12k->4k. Calls return 200s, latency per-request steady.
sam.h: Repro curl they ran: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-16k","input":["...repeated..."],"batch_size":32}'```
lia.k: Important: tokens/sec stable but vectors/sec low suggests batching/kvcache or GPU queue bottleneck. Any queue depth alerts?
infra-bot: Alert: vec-queue-depth spike on cluster nimbus-13 at 2024-05-13T02:05Z. avg_queue_depth -> 48 (threshold 20).
gpu-watch: GPU util on nimbus-13 at spike: 40% avg, scheduler backlog high. Looks like many small jobs piling up, not single model hogging.
sam.h: Interesting — GPU util low but queue depth high. Could be tiny batches dominating throughput due to dimension mismatch or fallback to CPU path?
support-jeff: Customer logs show occasional dim warnings: "expected dim 1536 got 1530" but no errors — we coerce? They said this started after a client-side preprocessing change.
lia.k: That matches: if a request falls back to a slower codepath (dim conversion/zero-pad) throughput per vector drops. Ask for request payload sample (headers + probe batch). Also check batch windows: autosplit or batcher may be shrinking effective batch size.
sam.h: I asked for a payload sample — customer sent anonymized snippet: most items length vary, some empty strings. They also switched to streaming uploads.
support-jeff: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) many zero-length inputs + batch=32 -> vecs/sec halved. 2) Forceconsistent length -> back to baseline.
lia.k: Run an internal probe against nimbus-13 with synthetic mix (16 empty, 16 normal) to measure kernel path. Use: ```python3 probes/vec_probe.py --model redwood-embed-16k --batch 32 --mix 50```
sam.h: Doing that now. If repro holds we'll ask infra to pin routing away from nimbus-13 and propose customer mitigation: validate input dims + avoid empty docs while we patch batching heuristics.
gpu-watch: Probe run results: mixed batch throughput 3.8k vec/s, clean batch throughput 11.9k vec/s. KV-cache bucket shows frequent small allocations.
lia.k: Ok actionable: (1) Support: ask customer to validate/preprocess to consistent inputs (avoid empty). (2) Infra: add a temporary routing rule to shift their requests off nimbus-13 (canary of 1h). (3) Runtime: add metric to detect dim-coercion fallback path and emit a warning.
support-jeff: Sent mitigation steps to customer and scheduled a short capacity shift. Customer accepts short routing change.
sam.h: Filed follow-up internal ticket INF-5892 for runtime metric + backfill logs. Will monitor vecs/sec for next 2 hours. :thumbsup:
lia.k: Thanks — keep updates here. If shift doesn't help we escalate to runtime eng to inspect padders/convert paths.
